def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells5 = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells5), max(r for r, c in cells5)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells5), max(c for r, c in cells5)
    pos2 = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2)
    pos8 = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 8)
    for r, row in enumerate(g):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v in (2, 8):
                g[r][c] = 7
    g[r0 - 1][pos8[1]] = 2
    g[r1][c1 + 1 if pos8[1] > pos2[1] else c0 - 1] = 8
    return g
